show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/UWmWqd
show.description:
A spoiled rich heir lives a carefree life at 30, still relying on generous pocket money from his powerful family.
But when his wealth is suddenly cut off, he’s forced to face the real world for the first time.
